_description: Covalent radii for elements by bond order (single, double, triple) in Angstroms. Source: First-principle calculations from Nikolaienko et al. (2019).
_reference: Nikolaienko, T. Y., Chuiko, V. S., & Bulavin, L. A. (2019). The covalent radii derived from the first-principle data. Computational and Theoretical Chemistry.
_note: Values derived from 26,050 molecular structures using quantum-chemical calculations. Single bond radii are recommended for general use. Double and triple bond radii available for enhanced accuracy when bond order is known.
